inputs.body:
Good morning,

I manage eighteen rental units across Marlow Ridge and Dunmore Flats. Our current plumber is retiring and we are looking for a company who can handle routine repairs and the occasional emergency. Do you offer a maintenance plan for multi-unit properties, and what would the pricing look like for our portfolio? I can send a unit list if that helps.

Regards,
Raymond Osei
Property Manager, Harborview Properties
inputs.subject: Maintenance contract for 18 rental units
